\section[(dialogue)]{Getting around and the town — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R116-first-pass-getting-around-and-the-town}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for gloves and a scarf.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a bicycle, the underground, a taxi, a car park, a lift
  \item a supermarket, a cinema, a stadium, a swimming pool, a grocer's shop
  \item an office; a desk, a factory, a pavement, a crossroads, a red light
  \item a border, the north, the south, the west, a letterbox
  \item the right, the left, the world, a journey, holidays
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A bicycle? (\textbf{le vélo}.) The underground? (\textbf{le métro}.) A taxi? (\textbf{le taxi}.) A car park? (\textbf{le parking}.) A lift? (\textbf{l'ascenseur}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{le supermarché}.) A cinema? (\textbf{le cinéma}.) A stadium? (\textbf{le stade}.) A swimming pool? (\textbf{la piscine}.) A grocer's shop? (\textbf{l'épicerie}.) An office; a desk? (\textbf{le bureau}.) A factory? (\textbf{l'usine}.) A pavement? (\textbf{le trottoir}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{le carrefour}.) A red light? (\textbf{le feu rouge}.) A border? (\textbf{la frontière}.) The north? (\textbf{le nord}.) The south? (\textbf{le sud}.) The west? (\textbf{l'ouest}.) A letterbox? (\textbf{la boîte aux lettres}.) The right? (\textbf{la droite}.) The left? (\textbf{la gauche}.) The world? (\textbf{le monde}.) A journey? (\textbf{le voyage}.) Holidays? (\textbf{les vacances}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R116-second-pass-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a rug and a television.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a rug, a television, a computer, a fridge, a radio
  \item a shower, a bathtub, a wardrobe, a shelf, a curtain
  \item a pillow, a blanket, a towel; a napkin, soap, a toothbrush
  \item toothpaste, shampoo, a comb, a bin, a broom
  \item a vacuum cleaner, laundry, washing powder; the washing, iron; an iron, a pocket
  \item a jacket, a tie, a belt, gloves, a scarf
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A rug? (\textbf{le tapis}.) A television? (\textbf{la télévision}.) A computer? (\textbf{l'ordinateur}.) A fridge? (\textbf{le réfrigérateur}.) A radio? (\textbf{la radio}.) A shower? (\textbf{la douche}.) A bathtub? (\textbf{la baignoire}.) A wardrobe? (\textbf{l'armoire}.) A shelf? (\textbf{l'étagère}.) A curtain? (\textbf{le rideau}.) A pillow? (\textbf{l'oreiller}.) A blanket? (\textbf{la couverture}.) A towel; a napkin? (\textbf{la serviette}.) Soap? (\textbf{le savon}.) A toothbrush? (\textbf{la brosse à dents}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{le dentifrice}.) Shampoo? (\textbf{le shampooing}.) A comb? (\textbf{le peigne}.) A bin? (\textbf{la poubelle}.) A broom? (\textbf{le balai}.) A vacuum cleaner? (\textbf{l'aspirateur}.) Laundry? (\textbf{le linge}.) Washing powder; the washing? (\textbf{la lessive}.) Iron; an iron? (\textbf{le fer}.) A pocket? (\textbf{la poche}.) A jacket? (\textbf{la veste}.) A tie? (\textbf{la cravate}.) A belt? (\textbf{la ceinture}.) Gloves? (\textbf{les gants}.) A scarf? (\textbf{l'écharpe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
